mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE owner_type = 'USER' AND owner_id = #{userId} AND status != 2 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE owner_type = 'USER' AND owner_id = #{userId} AND status != 2
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_size), 0) FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE owner_type = 'USER' AND owner_id = #{userId} AND status != 2
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_base SET status = 2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_type = 'USER' AND owner_id = #{userId} AND status != 2

UPDATE ai_knowledge_base SET document_count = ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_knowledge_document d WHERE d.kb_id = #{id} AND d.status != 2 ), total_size = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.file_size), 0) FROM ai_knowledge_document d WHERE d.kb_id = #{id} AND d.status != 2 ), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
